summary: Health Catalyst filed an 8-K disclosing a workforce reduction of ~9% and elimination of ~100 open headcount positions as part of 'Project Nexus,' a strategic initiative to transform its operating model and reduce cost structure. The filing also notes that Chief People Officer Linda Llewelyn will depart effective June 1, 2026 due to role elimination, with a transition to a senior advisor role. No financial terms, premium, or deal structure are provided. The company expects to disclose further details in its upcoming 10-Q. Watch for additional cost-saving measures and potential restructuring charges.
